title: The Legend of Zelda Tears of the Kingdom Secrets of the Zonai Book Delayed to March 2027
text:
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Secrets of the Zonai hardcover book hits March 30, 2027, after a delay from October 2026, with Standard and Hero editions.
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Secrets of the Zonai, a new hardcover book from Dark Horse, is now set to release on March 30, 2027. Originally scheduled for October 2026, the book was delayed and will arrive as Nintendo continues to expand The Legend of Zelda franchise with multiple projects, including an Ocarina of Time remake and other releases planned for 2027.
Secrets of the Zonai Book Details
The book covers behind-the-scenes information about Tears of the Kingdom, detailed breakdowns of the Zonai and their history prior to the game, concept art, and photos. It is a 472-page hardback compilation designed for fans interested in the lore of Hyrule. The Standard Edition, priced at $59.99, includes only the book with a cover featuring assorted characters from Tears of the Kingdom. The Hero Edition, priced at $119.99, adds a green slipcase, an exclusive cover, an art print of Link and the Sages, a cloth map showcasing the depths of Hyrule, and a Zelda Tear replica. Both versions can be pre-ordered from the official Dark Horse store.
2027 Release Schedule for Zelda Fans
Beyond the Secrets of the Zonai book, Nintendo has kept most of its plans for 2027 under wraps. However, a lore-heavy prequel release is also expected that year, joining the upcoming remaster. This prequel delves deep into the history of Hyrule leading up to the events of one of the best Legend of Zelda games, offering behind-the-scenes information, photos, concept art, and more. It will be a hardback book aimed at dedicated devotees and collectors. Additionally, a staggeringly exorbitant $519.99 Legend of Zelda project is on the horizon, though details remain scarce.
Context and Fan Expectations
The Secrets of the Zonai book may be the closest fans get to another Wilds-era Zelda project, which is a disappointment for those hoping for a new game. Nevertheless, this lore-filled book serves as a great addition to any collection or a companion piece to one of the best Legend of Zelda games ever made. Tears of the Kingdom originally released on May 12, 2023, for Nintendo Switch, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version also available. It holds a Top Critic Average of 95/100 on OpenCritic with a 97% critic recommendation. The game is rated E for Everyone 10+ for Fantasy Violence and Mild Suggestive Themes, developed and published by Nintendo, and uses the Havok engine.
Delays and Availability
The delay of the Secrets of the Zonai book from October 2026 to March 30, 2027, gives fans more time to anticipate its release. Pre-orders are open through Dark Horse, and the book will be available in both Standard and Hero editions. As Nintendo continues to celebrate The Legend of Zelda series, this book offers an in-depth look at the Zonai and their role in Tears of the Kingdom. With the Ocarina of Time remake and other 2027 releases on the way, the franchise remains a major focus for Nintendo.
